summary: Reviewed LeanPool subtree bucket 1; retain all 398 files because they are mathematical formalizations with definitions, lemmas, and theorem-development support.

review_evidence: All 502 listed paths resolve in reservoir-sources/Vilin97__lean-pool, and every byte size matches the brief.

Read in full the 14 files that have no declaration keyword: AsymptoticTrianglePacking/Internal/Prelude.lean, JacobianDiffgeo/{Dbar,H1Genus,Init,ProperDegree,RiemannRoch}.lean, LeanPolyABC/All.lean, LowWeightPauliDynamics/Schur.lean, Rupert/Attr.lean, Rupert/Equivalences/AffineRupertEquivRupertSet.lean, Rupert/MatrixSimps.lean, TwoColoringOneRound/LowerBound.lean, TwoColoringOneRound/UpperBound.lean, TwoColoringOneRound/UpperBound/Recursive3Param.lean.

LeanPool/Rupert/Attr.lean runs `register_simp_attr matrix_simps`. LeanPool/Rupert/MatrixSimps.lean declares `dsimproc_decl matrixReduceNatAdd` and `matrixNormalizeFin` and runs an `attribute [matrix_simps]` command over about 40 Matrix lemmas. Both files hold formal commands, so they are not import-only.

LeanPool/JacobianDiffgeo/RiemannRoch.lean, ProperDegree.lean, H1Genus.lean, and Dbar.lean are re-export roots. Their docstrings give the exported statements with full signatures (riemannRoch, riemann_inequality, divisor_degree_eq_zero, finrank_H1Tail_zero_eq_genus, exists_dbar_solution_ball), and each ends with `@[expose] public section`.
LeanPool/JacobianDiffgeo/Init.lean (354 bytes, the smallest file) holds a module header, a project docstring, and `@[expose] public section`, with no imports.

LeanPool/AsymptoticTrianglePacking/Internal/Prelude.lean and LeanPool/LowWeightPauliDynamics/Schur.lean hold only public imports and a docstring. FILTER-007 with FD-016 keeps such modules primary-eligible and ranks them as navigation-import-only, so they are retained.

LeanPool/Burkholder/Majorants/MajorantPG2.lean (460162 bytes, the largest file) builds the Burkholder majorant for p > 2 and has 310 top-level def/theorem/lemma declarations. MajorantPL2.lean (432779 bytes) has 352 declarations.

LeanPool/TwoColoringOneRound/LowerBound/N1000000Data.lean is auto-generated certificate data with typed `def` constants (n, numVars, D, ...) in namespace Distributed2Coloring.LowerBound.N1000000Data. N1000000Main.lean refers to them (`abbrev n : Nat := N1000000Data.n`), so the file is part of the proof.

A junk-signal grep (lorem/ipsum/placeholder/dummy/asdf) found only 'placeholder-free and axiom-clean' docstrings in AsymptoticTrianglePacking/Internal/*, design notes in JacobianDiffgeo, and 'Dummy values otherwise' comments on witness encodings in N1000000MuWitness.lean. None of these marks junk.

A TODO/FIXME/XXX grep found five ordinary comments on real declarations: JacobianDiffgeo/Finiteness/Chain.lean (resolved TODO(blocker) notes), LeanPolyABC/Lib/Radical.lean:179, and Rupert/Square.lean:35.

Subdirectory samples: Erdos865/Defs.lean defines HasTriple, IsTripleFree, and lowSums. GrothendieckVanishing/ClosedImmersion.lean defines closedIncl and proves lemmas about it. KaltonRoberts/Collections.lean defines the structure WeightedCollection and its lemmas. ChipFiring/ChipFiringWithLean.lean is a library root with public imports and `@[expose] public section`.
summary: Reviewed all 502 listed files under LeanPool/@subtrees/1 (subdirectories AsymptoticTrianglePacking, Burkholder, ChipFiring, Erdos865, GrothendieckVanishing, JacobianDiffgeo, KaltonRoberts, LeanPolyABC, LowWeightPauliDynamics, Rupert, TwoColoringOneRound). Every listed byte size matched the checkout. A declaration-keyword grep left 14 files with no declaration keyword; each was read in full. Twelve are module-root re-export files that carry an `@[expose] public section` command, and several carry substantial API docstrings that name the exported theorems (Riemann-Roch, dbar-solvability, H1 genus, proper-map degree). Rupert/Attr.lean registers the `matrix_simps` simp attribute, and Rupert/MatrixSimps.lean declares two dsimprocs and an `attribute [matrix_simps]` command. Only AsymptoticTrianglePacking/Internal/Prelude.lean and LowWeightPauliDynamics/Schur.lean are pure import-plus-docstring files. FILTER-007 puts the attribute, section, and simproc files outside the unilateral import-only class. Under FD-016, verified import-only modules stay primary-eligible and are ranked after ordinary content, not excluded, so the two pure-import files also stay. Large data, witness, and certificate files hold real definitions and proofs. All files are retained.
